description: Best, average, median, worst and margin-free fair price per market line across bookmakers, with which bookmakers have the best price. The compact way to answer 'where is the best price' or 'what is the fair price'. Pass one eventId, or up to 10 comma-separated ids (one request). Growth plan and above; lower plans get a sample response marked demo: true, which is not real data, so tell the user.

bookmakers.description: Optional: restrict to some of the key's selected bookmakers

eventId.description: One event ID, or up to 10 comma-separated event IDs

includeExchanges.description: Add a separate block with the best exchange back price per outcome and its liquidity

lines.description: main (default): each market's main line. all: every line priced by 3+ bookmakers

markets.description: Comma-separated market names, case-insensitive, max 20. Default ML,Spread,Totals

name: get_odds_summary
title: Odds summary (best, average, fair)
